source_revision_note: Original engines are the baseline commit. Candidate runs used modified working-tree source based on that parent; exact file hashes, not the parent commit alone, identify the tested candidate.

experiment.session: 08:00-16:00 UTC, one minute local tick warmup
experiment.chronology_caveat: Additional later dates not used to choose these changes; October itself appeared in previous research and is not a pristine unseen dataset
changes: Micro persistent burst requires 15-second signed path persistence at the existing .55 confidence threshold
Momentum strong-candle continuation requires directional M15 context and observed 5-second persistence >= .55
Adaptive and Basket selection rank ordinal regime suitability before planned reward/risk; same-suitability opposing ambiguity remains blocked
experiment.acceptance: Report all individual and combined results; lower loss/inactivity alone does not establish profitability. No repeated return-driven parameter sweeps. Preserve baseline and candidate evidence even if unsuccessful.
experiment.monthly_return_goal: 20% monthly remains an aspirational aggressive objective, not a measured expectation or guarantee

limitations: Dates are explicit in sessions; October was already used in earlier research, not untouched market validation
Scenario broker specs, commission and leverage must be replaced by actual customer broker evidence
5-second decision cadence differs from 200ms live worker; every original quote checks broker stops and targets
Zero order latency, no partial fills/requotes/disconnects; does not qualify live execution
No retained historical economic calendar; production fails closed without one
Selected sessions cannot establish monthly return, profitable-month percentage, survival probability or fee viability
No claim that new strategies are profitable or commercially qualified
